title: EBiDAN’s ‘Yes! Tokyo’ Logs Third Week at No. 1 on Japan Hot 100 as Aimyon’s ‘Marigold’ Returns to Top 10 After Six Years
contentText:
EBiDAN’s “Yes! Tokyo” holds atop the Billboard Japan Hot 100, logging its third week at No. 1 on the chart dated Sept. 16.

EBiDAN’s 15th-anniversary track, released digitally Aug. 11, first topped the chart on the Aug. 19 dated list before reclaiming No. 1 three weeks later on Sep. 9. This week, overall points dip to 83% of last week’s total, but enough to secure a second consecutive week at No. 1. The track continues to rule video views and also tops streaming this week.

SixTONES’ “Dance Forever” is at No. 2. The title track of the group’s 18th single “Dance Forever / My Only,” released physically Sept. 9, launched with 430,312 copies to top sales. M!LK’s “Jiku Koete Universe” debuts at No. 3. The lead track from the group’s first mini-album LOVE ENG!NE and the concluding chapter of a love-themed trilogy, the track scored the most downloads this week at 15,829 units. SKE48’s “Tameiki Mirai,” the title track of the group’s 37th single, debuts at No. 4.

Aimyon’s “Marigold” surges 23-5. First released in 2018, the singer-songwriter’s signature hit climbed to No. 1 on radio airplay following buzz around a retrospective video celebrating the 10th anniversary of her major-label debut, as well as a full-length acoustic performance on a Sept. 4 radio broadcast. Overall points grew 275% week-over-week, sending the track into the top 10 for the first time in approximately six years and three months.

Mrs. GREEN APPLE’s “Brand New” follows at No. 6, =LOVE’s “Koi, Hajimemashita.” at No. 7, Motoki Ohmori’s “Haiiro” at No. 8, M!LK’s “Sukisugite Metsu!” at No. 9, and Spitz’s “Mishiranu Ito” at No. 10. YAO’s “Arifureta Sekai no Hate ni” — featuring Awich, CHICO CARLITO, ONE OK ROCK, and Paledusk — debuts at No. 11, posting strong numbers on both downloads and streaming.

The Billboard Japan Hot 100 combines physical and digital sales, audio streams, radio airplay, video views and karaoke data.

See the full Billboard Japan Hot 100 chart, tallying the week from Sept. 7 to 13, here ( https://www.billboard.com/charts/japan-hot-100/ ). For more on Japanese music and charts, visit Billboard Japan’s English X account ( https://x.com/BillboardJP_ENG ).
